attempts.summary: Configured node1 as the cluster's internal chrony time source (local stratum 10, allow 10.100.29.0/24, NTP opened in firewalld) and node2 to sync against node1 (server 10.100.29.10 iburst) instead of the public pool, implemented via an Ansible playbook run from node3 (the control node, only node with ansible/ansible-playbook installed). Since ansible-core 2.20 requires Python 3 on managed nodes and the RHEL7 nodes only have Python 2 with no package repos reachable (isolated cluster), tasks against node1/node2 use ansible.builtin.raw, which bypasses the module subsystem. Verified node2 reached '^*' synced state against node1 (stratum 11, NTP synchronized: yes). Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes: captured baseline boot_id and health, rebooted, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, and confirmed chrony/firewall config and sync recovered after each restart, then re-ran the playbook post-restarts to confirm end-to-end health.
